name: Hello World — File Creation
description: Learn to create a text file with content using VO1D's write_file action.

tasks.description: Create a file named hello.txt in the sandbox directory containing the text 'Hello, World!'
Create a file named greeting.txt containing 'Welcome to VO1D training'
tasks.expected_outcome: greeting.txt exists with the greeting message

tasks.description: Create a file named info.txt with at least 3 lines of text about what VO1D can do
tasks.expected_outcome: info.txt exists with multi-line content about VO1D
